page.overview:
Who is Heinz Brendel?

Heinz Brendel (born 16 January 1915 – 1 December, 1989) was a German racing driver, taking part for Daimler-Benz.

He took part in one European Championship race, the 1939 German Grand Prix, retiring after three laps after an accident in his Daimler-Benz AG.
